name: cavemio-week-calendar
title: Week calendar
description: A scheduling week you hold in the hand: drag a slot into an event while its times roll, and anything it lands on eases aside.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The hours are a focusable group: arrow keys move a slot outline, Enter adds an event there, Page Up and Page Down change the range. Tab reaches the events.
- On an event, arrow keys move it by a step or a day, Shift with up or down changes its length, Enter renames it and Delete removes it. Each change is announced with the new day and times, and any clash.
- Each event is labelled with its title, day and times; busy time is a note, so it's read but never focused.
- Gestures report a change of step, not every pointer move, so a drag re-renders a handful of times a second; events move with eased top, left, width and height on their own layer while held.
- On touch the hours scroll as usual; holding 360ms picks up (with a short vibration where supported), and only then does the page stop scrolling under the finger.
- Reduced motion moves events in place, without glides, slides or shakes; rings, colours and announcements still say what happened.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: events
props.description: – · Controlled events: { id, title, start, end, tone?, busy? }. Events on days in view are shown; tone picks one of the five chart colours.

props.name: onEventsChange
props.description: – · Every change at once, before any save settles.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: – · A new event once it's named. Resolve with the stored event to take its id; throw to take it back.

props.name: onUpdate
props.description: – · An event moved or resized. Throw to put it back.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: – · Delete or Backspace on an event. Throw to bring it back.

props.name: date
props.description: – · Controlled: any day in the range to show.

props.name: days
props.description: "auto" · "auto" shows 7 from 560px wide, 3 from 300px, otherwise 1. 5 is Monday to Friday.

props.name: defaultDuration
props.description: 30 · Length of an event made by a click or a hold.

props.name: locale
props.description: – · For weekday, date and time formats (12 or 24 hour follows it).

features.title: Drag to create
features.description: Press an empty slot and drag. A block grows with its times rolling, and you name it when you let go. A click makes a 30-minute event.

features.title: Move across days
features.description: An event keeps the point you grabbed it by, snaps to 15 minutes and jumps from day to day.

features.title: Overlaps resolve while you hold
features.description: Events it lands on ease aside into columns, and the clash is spelled out in amber.

features.title: Resize and auto-scroll
features.description: Drag an edge to resize. Near the top or bottom, the hours scroll themselves.

features.title: Fits any width
features.description: Seven days wide, three in a narrow card, one on a phone, where you hold to pick up so a swipe still scrolls.

features.title: Saves can fail
features.description: Changes show at once. If onUpdate or onCreate throws, the event goes back with a shake and a line says what happened.

states.title: create
states.description: Pressing an empty slot and dragging grows a block from the slot you pressed, snapped to the step (15 minutes); its top, height and times ease 200ms between steps. A click makes a 30-minute event. Letting go opens a name field in the block; Enter keeps it, Escape folds it away.

states.title: move
states.description: After 4px (or a 360ms hold on touch) the event lifts: a stronger ring, 1.015 scale, above the rest. It keeps the offset you grabbed it by, snaps in time, jumps day to day, and its times roll in the direction they changed.

states.title: overlap
states.description: Every step re-solves the columns for each day with the held event in them, so events it lands on narrow and slide aside (260ms) before you let go; a tall event says "Overlaps …" in amber while it's held there.

states.title: resize
states.description: The top and bottom 6px of an event resize it, never shorter than one step and never past the visible hours.

states.title: scroll
states.description: Within 40px of the top or bottom of the hours, they scroll themselves at up to 14px a frame, faster the closer you are, and the held event follows the grid.

states.title: range
states.description: ‹ › and Today slide the events in 32px from the side you went toward through a blur (460ms); day numbers roll that way and the range morphs.

states.title: saving
states.description: A new event shows a sweep of light while onCreate runs. A move, resize or delete that throws is put back, shakes, and a line under the header says what happened for 3.2s.
